(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said columnar body has a polygonal configuration.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, with at least two diodes on each face of the polygonal configuration of the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, with a diode mounted on each respective face.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face, with at least one diode being positioned at the center of each face.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, and further includes a dimming control feature.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said fins are arranged in a staggered configuration, creating equal angular spacing between adjacent fins and diodes.
